description: Registry of economically-testable betting strategies. Each key is a strategy_id consumed by src/betting.py:go_gate(). A strategy's verdict never authorizes any other strategy_id — an entry missing from this file, or a strategy_id not passed at all, is always NO-GO. Adding or changing an entry, or changing which verdict file/key it points at, is a human decision — the same standard as any other change under docs/PAST_ATTEMPT_LEDGER.md's decision contract.

f1/winner-pre-event/v1.description: Pre-event race winner, Elo/Plackett-Luce vs starting-grid baseline (the original Fase 0-1 strategy).
f1/winner-pre-event/v1.note: H1-F1 is REFUTADA (docs/RELATORIO_FASE1.md) — this strategy is NO-GO. No CLI path currently exercises pure pre-event winner betting; kept registered for when/if one does, so it inherits the real tested verdict instead of a placeholder.
